explanation: The text omits the confidence intervals (24.8 mo CI 22.1–NE; 14.5 mo CI 12.9–17.1) and that PFS was investigator-assessed, presenting point estimates as more precise/certain than the evidence indicates.
suggested_rewrite: ...median PFS was 24.8 months (95% CI, 22.1–not estimable) with palbociclib plus letrozole versus 14.5 months (95% CI, 12.9–17.1) with placebo, as investigator-assessed, meeting the primary endpoint.
